title: Domination-packing ratio for planar and unit disk graphs
summary: The domination number $γ(G)$ of a graph $G$ is the smallest possible size of a vertex set that intersects every radius-$1$ ball of $G$, and the packing number $ρ(G)$ is the maximum number of pairwise vertex-disjoint radius-$1$ balls. We prove that $\frac{γ(G)}{ρ(G)}\le 5$ for every planar graph and $\frac{γ(G)}{ρ(G)} \le \frac{18\sqrt3}π\approx 9.924$ for every unit disk graph, thus yielding Erdős-Pósa-type bounds for the hypergraph of radius-$1$ balls in the two graph classes.
